choices.grid: 250 m cells in EPSG:5070 (the hydrofabric's projection); active where a cell's center is within the 16 catchments plus a 2 km buffer [A]
choices.top: USGS 3DEP 1 arc-second land surface, averaged to each cell
choices.layers: 3 layers, following SIR 2010-5109's scheme of glacial layers by depth (Table 3B): layer 1 the upper 30.5 m (100 ft) of drift; layer 2 the rest of the drift; layer 3 the upper 30 m of bedrock [A]. Each layer at least 1 m thick [A]
choices.drift: Quaternary sediment thickness from USGS SIM 3392 (Soller and Garrity 2018, 500 m, from 1:1,000,000 isopachs at 0, 50, 100, 200, 400 ft): regional only
choices.glacial K: by Farrand and Bell (1982) map unit at each cell's center, calibrated values from SIR 2010-5109 (Table 5-2); layer 2 the southern Lower Peninsula geometric mean (Table 9-1) [A]
choices.bedrock K: by Milstein (1987) subcrop formation, from SIR 2010-5109 (App. 4, Tables 5-1 and 5-2) [A where noted in BEDROCK]
choices.storage: specific yield 0.15 and specific storage 1e-5 per m in every layer [A]; transmissivity held at its value for the full layer thickness (ICELLTYPE 0) [A]
choices.recharge: CFE's daily percolation (SOIL_TO_GW_FLUX) by catchment, from the calibrated NextGen run; buffer cells take their nearest catchment's rate [A]
choices.rivers: RIV in every cell a hydrofabric flowpath crosses: streambed at the cell's lowest 30 m DEM value; bottom 1 m below it; conductance 0.3 m/d (bed K) x channel top width (hydrofabric TopWdth) x length in the cell / 1 m [A]; stage = streambed + the day's t-route depth
choices.seepage: DRN in every other layer-1 cell at land surface, conductance = layer 1 Kv x cell area / 1 m [A], so the water table can't rise above the land surface and discharges there (wetlands, unmapped streams)
choices.edges: GHB at the outer ring of active cells in layers 1 and 2, head from the water table interpolated from Wellogic drift wells (inverse distance, the 12 nearest) [A], conductance = Kh x thickness x 250 m / 250 m [A]
choices.start: steady state under the run's mean recharge and mean river depth
choices.campus well: one well in cat-652066, about 500 m from the nearest river cell (nextgen-michigan's Glover case) and nearest the catchment's center, screened in layer 2 [A]
choices.existing pumping: not included: EGLE's facility-level water use has no locations, and Wellogic's high-capacity wells have capacities, not withdrawals [A]

baseflow.modflow6: gross discharge to streams (aquifer to stream only); flooded rivers' losses to the aquifer are excluded, as separated base flow has none

balance.ledger: closed every day of both runs (the driver stops otherwise)

campus_wells.note: the replayed NextGen flow less MODFLOW 6's depletion; t-route doesn't see the well

glover.source: nextgen-michigan docs/note.md: own wells, sewered wastewater; wells 500 m from the stream, T 500 m2/d, Sy 0.1 [A]; April 2019 to December 2022
